title: Introduction to Machine Learning
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 12 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)
description: Covers statistical decision theory, linear regression and classification, SVMs, neural networks, decision trees, ensembles, graphical models, clustering, EM and an introduction to learning theory and reinforcement learning. Assumes basic probability, linear algebra and programming.

title: Deep Learning
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 12 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)
description: Building blocks of deep networks: MLPs, backpropagation, gradient-descent variants (momentum, Adam, RMSProp), autoencoders, regularisation, batch normalisation, word vectors, CNN architectures, RNNs/LSTMs and attention. Needs linear algebra and probability.

title: Programming, Data Structures and Algorithms using Python
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 8 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)
description: First programming course in Python: control flow, lists and dictionaries, searching and sorting, complexity, recursion, classes, linked lists, binary search trees, memoization and dynamic programming.

title: Natural Language Processing
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 12 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)
description: Text processing, spelling correction, language models and smoothing, POS tagging, MaxEnt/CRF sequence models, constituency and dependency parsing, distributional and lexical semantics, topic models, information extraction, summarisation and sentiment analysis.

title: Python for Data Science
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 4 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)
description: Short applied course: Python basics, NumPy arrays, Pandas data handling and visualisation, ending with regression and classification case studies.

title: Reinforcement Learning
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 12 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)
description: Mathematical foundations of RL: bandits, MDPs, Bellman optimality, dynamic programming and TD methods, eligibility traces, function approximation, DQN, policy gradients, hierarchical RL and POMDPs.

title: Data Base Management System
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)

title: Essential Mathematics for Machine Learning
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 12 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)

title: Probability and Statistics
licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
duration_basis: estimate: 12 weeks x ~2.5 h video/week (NPTEL syllabus)

licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)

licence: CC BY-SA (NPTEL; version not stated on pages read)
